reason: Both conversations correctly issued the safety stop and refused further resets, but Conversation 1 went on to explain the heater-linked timing pattern, asked sensible confirming questions (timing, burning smell, plug condition), and directed the homeowner to an appliance engineer specifically for an earth/insulation test of the heater element, matching the expected direction. Conversation 2 gave only a bare stop-and-call-someone message with no diagnosis, no questions about water near the socket, and no explanation of why the fault is likely heater-related. Conversation 1's slight overreach ('the timing confirms it') is a minor weakness, but it still framed the engineer's test as the deciding step rather than recommending a part outright.
